skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Apply curated color palettes and font pairings to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.
skill.summary: Style presentation and document artifacts with preset or custom professional themes.
skill.author: 7Spade

security_audit.summary: The apparent external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around filenames and directory names in SKILL.md. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed instructions, but theme-showcase.pdf remains a low-severity manual review item because it is an unscanned binary asset.

remediation.issue: Binary PDF asset was not statically inspected.
remediation.suggestion: Review theme-showcase.pdf with trusted PDF tooling before publishing, and consider providing an extracted text or image-only preview for easier auditability.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks wrap the filename theme-showcase.pdf in Markdown text. This is a display instruction, not shell or Ruby command execution.
The backticks wrap the filename theme-showcase.pdf in prose. No command invocation or executable context is present.
The backticks wrap the directory name themes/ in Markdown. It describes where theme files live and does not execute external commands.
The instruction is to read a local directory path shown in Markdown backticks. It does not ask the agent to run a shell command or interpolate user input.
The PDF is a binary asset that static analysis could not inspect, and local rendering failed due missing PDF tooling. This is kept as a low-severity review item rather than dismissed.

content.value_statement: Unstyled decks and documents can look inconsistent or unfinished. Theme Factory helps Claude apply curated colors and fonts to artifacts with clear review steps.
actual_capabilities: Shows a visual PDF showcase of ten preset themes for user selection.
Applies selected theme colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Reads detailed theme specifications from local Markdown files in the themes directory.
Supports custom theme generation when preset themes do not fit the artifact.
Guides the assistant to confirm theme selection before applying changes.
limitations: It depends on the assistant and host tool to edit the target artifact format.
It does not automatically validate color contrast beyond the written instruction to ensure readability.
It provides preset visual direction, not full brand guideline enforcement.
The PDF showcase requires a viewer or PDF rendering support in the user environment.

use_cases.title: Style an executive slide deck
use_cases.description: Apply a polished theme to an existing presentation before stakeholder review.

use_cases.title: Create consistent client reports
use_cases.description: Use one palette and font pairing across report sections for a unified client deliverable.

use_cases.title: Prototype a branded landing page
use_cases.description: Select or generate a theme, then apply it to an HTML artifact for rapid visual exploration.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for selecting from the showcase
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Theme Factory showcase and help me choose a theme for my presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after the user has chosen one preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck. Keep the layout, but update colors and fonts consistently.

prompt_templates.title: Match a target audience
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask the assistant to recommend a suitable preset
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Theme Factory theme for a technical investor update. Explain the choice, then wait for my approval before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a custom theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for custom visual direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a premium healthcare analytics report. Use calm colors, strong readability, and a modern professional tone. Show the theme before applying it.

output_examples.input: Apply a clean theme to my quarterly report.
output_examples.output: The assistant shows the theme showcase, recommends Modern Minimalist for a clean report style, and asks for confirmation before updating the artifact.

output_examples.input: Use a warm and energetic style for this launch deck.
output_examples.output: The assistant suggests Sunset Boulevard or Golden Hour, explains the visual tradeoff, and applies the chosen palette and fonts after approval.

output_examples.input: None of the presets fit our nonprofit brand.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a custom theme with suitable colors and font pairings, presents it for review, and then applies it consistently.

best_practices: Review the showcase before choosing a theme so the visual direction is clear.
Confirm the selected theme before applying changes to important artifacts.
Check readability after applying colors, especially on charts, tables, and small text.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme without user confirmation when several styles could fit.
Do not mix multiple preset themes in one artifact unless the user asks for contrast.
Do not prioritize decorative colors over legibility and consistent hierarchy.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps an assistant apply curated colors and font pairings to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with a named visual identity and supporting theme file.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions support generating a new theme when none of the presets match the artifact.

faq.question: Does it edit files by itself?
faq.answer: No. It guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to apply theme choices using the tools available in the current environment.

faq.question: Is it only for slide decks?
faq.answer: No. The skill also mentions documents, reports, HTML landing pages, and other artifacts.

faq.question: Should I review the result?
faq.answer: Yes. Review contrast, fonts, and layout after the theme is applied, especially for audience-facing materials.
